description: Golden evaluation cases for simon-footprint-profiler covering Phase B concurrent footprint profiling, zero-decode oEmbed media links, deterministic Python math, and adversarial edge cases.

cases.description: Clean valid pass case for a multi-release emerging artist with live oEmbed embeddable links, YouTube reach, Bandcamp supporter counts, and deterministic 75.0% view share math.
cases.brief: Profile public reach, oEmbed media queue, and concentration share for resolved subject lead_mira_sol.
cases.context: Tool url_context returned 2 live oEmbed embeddable videos: 1) 'Mira Sol - Midnight Train (Live Session)', author Sofar Sounds, duration 215s, embeddable true, view count 18000; 2) 'Mira Sol - Paper Walls (Acoustic)', author Mira Sol, duration 192s, embeddable true, view count 6000. YouTube channel subscriber count is 4200. Bandcamp catalog has 3 releases, 84 supporters, and 9 released tracks. Python code execution computed total sampled views = 24000, top view share = 18000 / 24000 * 100 = 75.0%, and classified regime as early_dsp_inflection.

process_trace.notes: Verified 2 media links via oEmbed; collected YouTube subscriber and top video metrics.
Gathered Bandcamp release count (3), supporter count (84), and track count (9).

newly_discovered_sources.why_useful: Active independent release catalog with 84 verified supporters and 3 EPs.
